sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement Ornith-1.5 takes a major step toward building foundation models through end-to-end self-improvement, extending the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts.
